notes.docker_stats: Docker-reported container working set, sampled at the configured interval.
notes.cgroup_memory_current: Container cgroup total, including anon and file cache.
notes.torrentng_process_rss: Host /proc RSS for torrentngd when available; zero means unavailable.
notes.process_memory_snapshots: TorrentNG /proc status, thread names, smaps totals, and the 20 largest resident mappings captured with cgroup samples.
notes.engine_metrics: TorrentNG resource-governor, peer-buffer, storage-pool and jemalloc metrics sampled during transfer and at phase boundaries.
notes.jemalloc_metrics: jemalloc allocated/active/resident/mapped/retained gauges sampled during TorrentNG phases; metrics are unavailable if jemalloc statistics are not compiled or supported.
